title: The Preacher Ran
subTitle: Every Grave is a Story
lyrics:
I tried to go… It was getting late.
A grave alone… Slowed my pace.
On this stone… A sinner's fate.
Words now moaned… The sound of hate.

Most fear, the guns of war.
Some fear, the swing of a sword.
Liars fear, their own front door.
This one fears, that and more.

The fight began… A fight to win.
There was no plan… A fight for kin.
This preacher ran… He knew he sinned.
When father Dan… Grabbed his gin.

Riley Kate… Was now aglow.
Told to wait… She didn't know.
Now she's late… And began to show.
This preacher mate… Had to go.

Most fear, the guns of war.
Some fear, the swing of a sword.
Liars fear, their own front door.
This one fears, that and more.

No one helped… The preacher hide.
Then he yelped… He knew he lied.
Dan had felt… A father's pride.
And with his belt… Dan did tie.

He made a noose… To do the deed.
His vengeance loose… The preacher's seed.
There was no truce… Just rage & speed.
No excuse… Now headstone reads.

Most fear, the guns of war.
Some fear, the swing of a sword.
Liars fear, their own front door.
This one fears, that and more.

And so it goes… No one wins.
Now we know… How hell begins.
But deep below… Revenge of kin.
He had to go… The preacher sinned.
bio: Pride, Family, and Revenge

title: Respect
subTitle: Stop & Say Thank You
lyrics:
Old wood floors… And 3 high tables.
Bar maid pours… From whiskey labels.
Men of war… Now rusty angels.
A time before… Fallen halos.

These men lead… With reputation…
Their pride needs… No explanation.
They did for me… Their generation…
Our flag is free… One God one nation.

I don't know how… To show respect.
I know somehow… I might regret.
I stare & now… They suspect.
My head just bowed… A bit direct.

These men lead… With reputation…
Their pride needs… No explanation.
They did for me… Their generation…
Our flag is free… One God one nation.

The old one looked… At me with pause.
I just stood… Without a cause.
My pride was true… But still felt flawed.
He just knew… Respect & awe.

These men lead… With reputation…
Their pride needs… No explanation.
They did for me… Their generation…
Our flag is free… One God one nation.

We never met… But I now see.
It's with regret… I let it be.
I should have said… More carefully.
My respect… Is my decree.

My thanks to you… I am me.
Because of you… We are free.
Respect is due… To you I see.
My thanks to you… My son will be.

These men lead… With reputation…
Their pride needs… No explanation.
They did for me… Their generation…
Our flag is free… One God one nation.
bio: Respect - Gratitude

title: Songs and Stitches
subTitle: Fun and Simple
lyrics:
Dug up & stole… From dusty old licks.
Songs are just old… Pieces & bits.
The good ones find… A rhythm or trick.
But most songs fold… And die in a fit.

Some songs steal… Or bend a rhyme.
To help you feel… That's not a crime.
But few are one… One of a kind.
Most are new… Like Frankenstein.

Steal a lyric, bend a rhyme.
Songs are just like… Frankenstein.
With borrowed notes that fall & climb.
With stitches & bolts, to help align.

Most old rhymes… From past times.
Are stole in body… And then in mind.
All from hearses… Like Frankenstein.
Become old verses… With really bad wine.

Steal a lyric, bend a rhyme.
Songs are just like… Frankenstein.
With borrowed notes that fall & climb.
With stitches & bolts, to help align.

Steal a lyric… Bend a rhyme… Songs are like… Frankenstein.

We need more wine…
bio: A Song About Songs

title: Angry Penguins
lyrics:
I used to be fast… A bounce in my step.
Thought it would last… I was the best. 
To run or dash… I was impressed. 
When people I passed… I'd puff up my chest.  

This story starts… When I'm not sure. 
When some of my parts… Just took a detour. 
They were not smart… Or even ensured. 
Like a wobbly cart… Grade A manure. 

We wobble to the left. We wobble to the right. Step by step. Is a brand-new fight. Knees don't work. Back ain't right. An angry wreck. Like a penguin fight.  

My left foot moans… That's a new one. 
My right knee groans… I know that one. 
A mind of its own… My hip thinks it's done. 
An ache in my bones… This just ain't fun. 

We wobble to the left. We wobble to the right. Step by step. Is a brand-new fight. Knees don't work. Back ain't right. An angry wreck. Like a penguin fight.  

I'd rather have… A beer instead. 
I just look mad… I'm not dead. 
I know this looks sad… It's all in my head. 
Yeah but this is bad… Just go to bed. 

We wobble to the left. We wobble to the right. Step by step. Is a brand-new fight. Knees don't work. Back ain't right. An angry wreck. Like a penguin fight.   

I feel a crash… My toe hurts.
My arm has a rash… My butt is worse
I need to scratch… I'm gonna burst. 
Gone in a flash… Silver alert.
bio: Getting Older

title: Devil's Quake
lyrics:
Far away… With the rising sun.
The soul of man… Had no where to run.
A town still small… Young in age. 
Born of hope… Silk & sage. 

The story's goes… The seasons late.  
The sea was cold… Bones would ache. 
God said no… To man's fate. 
Then shook… the devil awake. 

Why God… Why me… Could you not… Just let me be?

Out to sea… The ground shook. 
All came down… Nothing stood. 
Shock & awe… From shore to shore. 
Please God stop… But there was more. 

Hard they tried… Sons & daughters. 
They could not hide… From the waters. 
Drowned by sea… The story tells. 
Drowned by three… Waves from hell.

Why God… Why me… Could you not… Just let me be?

Many cried… There can't be more. 
Then from hills… The fires roared.
All the homes… Like not before.
A burning hell… Burned some more.

Why God… Why me… Could you not… Just let me be?

Then with time… It was quiet. 
The devil's crime… Was now silent. 
What was born… From silk & sage. 
Now just died… In angry rage. 

And God's reply… The why to me.  
Was quick & clear… You are free.
But I will not. Just let you be. 
Your time is now… To bend the knee.
bio: Yokohama Earthquake of 1923

title: Man with the Beard
lyrics:
5 feet strong… And a puff of smoke. 
Old jeans on… Far from woke.
Days are long… He's almost broke.
Not yet gone… Still with hope. 

The man defied… But time made clear. 
Hard was the ride… And long was his beard.
A limp in his stride… But he could still hear. 
Driven by pride… and 16 gears. 

38 tons & 18 tires. Coming in hot with wheels on fire. 
Right on time, under the wire. 38 tons & 18 tires.

A love for the ride… He was made strong. 
Still alive… But far from dawn. 
Once he cried… A pain he pawned. 
He tried to hide… But then it was gone. 

38 tons & 18 tires. Coming in hot with wheels on fire. 
Right on time, under the wire. 38 tons & 18 tires.

Home to rest… In time to pray. 
He did it best… All his way. 
The wild west… Some did say. 
But God he blessed… Most of the days. 

38 tons & 18 tires. Coming in hot with wheels on fire. 
Right on time, under the wire. 38 tons & 18 tires.

When he appeared… At heaven's gate.
The man with the beard… Knew his fate.   
He held high his beer… There was no wait. 
St. Peter now steered… He wasn't late.
bio: A Trucker's Journey

title: Hello Finnigan
lyrics:
On hills steep… Far from home.
Where the grass is deep… And the mind roams.
At the peak… Old white stones.
Very asleep… Dead & alone.

Headstones tell… Of love or sin.
Heaven & hell… and past kin.
This stone head… Made me grin.
All it said… Was Finnigan.

That's all… No goodbye.
No recall… Of when you died.
How did you fall… Or if you lied.
A deadly brawl… I had to know why.

And so my mind… Quickly framed.
A fable in kind… From only one name.
A story in time… Without shame.
A kin of mine… Our names the same.

Hello Finnigan. Who lived back when. You traveled the world. And back again.
Where were you going? Where have you been? It's good to see you my old friend.

The story cries… Your lost at sea.
How and why… At 23.
The crew defied… A mutiny.
Then you died… Hard to believe.

The soul of a gypsy… The heart of a king.
A life at sea… On angels wing.
Your love was she… A sea to sing.
Your life was free… Then 5 bells ring.

But if that is so… This can't be.
A headstone… That's NOT at sea.
Only I know… A lie you see.
As buried below… Is just your ring.

Hello Finnigan. Who lived back when. You traveled the world. And back again.
Where were you going? Where have you been? It's good to see you my old friend.
bio: Finnigan's Story

title: First Shot Fired
lyrics:
On this hill… Covered with sheep.
Blood was spilled… Now headstones peak.
My mind stilled… Hard to speak.
Who was killed… The truth I seek.

They all lay… Cold in the sun.
A war in one day… No where to run.
Kin they say… Brothers & sons.
No one prayed… All 20 when done.

War begins… With someone to blame.
War ends… Mostly the same.
Truth bends… To cover the shame.
Those in the end… Feel the pain.

First to fire… Was Finnigan
Defending a liar… His brother again.
His last desired… A pain & a sin.
A nun in the choir… Then the war begins.

On that day… Finnigan died.
In every way… No one cried.
Dead they say… But he was alive.
He ran away… His grave a lie.

War begins… With someone to blame.
War ends… Mostly the same.
Truth bends… To cover the shame.
Those in the end… Feel the pain.

Off to sea… On sails & wings.
He was free… Like a gypsy king.
But in the ground?… As few would sing.
Finnigan smiled… He forgot his ring.
bio: Finnigan Fired the First Shot

title: Hillbilly Rules
lyrics:
Yeah son… You're on my stool.
This is a bar… Not a school.
When I'm done… You can move.
It's not that hard… Just follow the rules.

Some call us redneck… That's hard to refuse.
We say hillbilly… That's kinda cool.
But what comes next… Is all up to you.
Mind your step… Here are the rules.

Respect is first… And all it invokes. Then comes defend… Stay at your post.
Live & let be… Praise God the most. For kin & country… Our hillbilly oath.

Everyone here… Is settled & set.
Life road em hard… Then put away wet.
Pride & beer… Are what we have left.
With all the scars… And a few regrets.

In here we matter… We follow the rules.
Out there we scatter… Some of us fools.
I hear the chatter… But stay on my stool.
With pride & swagger… Grandma approves.

Respect is first… And all it invokes. Then comes defend… Stay at your post.
Live & let be… Praise God the most. For kin & country… Our hillbilly oath.

In time we all die… But I choose to live.
With God as my guide… Each day I forgive.
In here I decide… Just how to live.
High is my pride… And all that it gives.

While your here… Still next to me.
In this bar… Of hillbilly's.
My gift so far… My pride you see.
But pay for your beer… That's not free.

Respect is first… And all it invokes. Then comes defend… Stay at your post.
Live & let be… Praise God the most. For kin & country… Our hillbilly oath.
bio: A Bar's Rules of Life

title: Knights Templar: Larger Than Life
lyrics:
One by one… Thousands were called.
From farms & fields… To castle walls.
Fathers & sons… Time recalls.
A templar's shield… Strong & tall.

A cross of red… On a mantel of white.
For God they said… The promise to fight.
To war & death… To protect what is right.
The legend spread… A templars knight.

Covered in steel… Chains & mace.
With cape & hood… To cover the face.
God made real… By the hell they chased.
Fight for the good… Then die in grace.

A shield in hand… A helmet of grey.
A sword that stands… Red cross displayed.
By God's command… Evil then paid.
Then on demand… They settle to pray.

Covered in steel… Chains & mace.
With cape & hood… To cover the face.
God made real… By the hell they chased.
Fight for the good… Then die in grace.

Heaven had gave… An angel of steel.
Man then made… The legend real.
Swords were raised… And honor revealed.
God had saved… When demons kneeled.

Covered in steel… Chains & mace.
With cape & hood… To cover the face.
God made real… By the hell they chased.
Fight for the good… Then die in grace.

Time has gone… But the legend stays.
Man moved on… But on this day.
A red cross made real… In every way.
My angel of steel… In God we pray.

Covered in steel… Chains & mace.
With cape & hood… To cover the face.
God made real… By the hell they chased.
Fight for the good… Then die in grace.

title: Knights Templar: Faith of Steel
lyrics:
A war for God… A time to choose.
A war for the lord… We cannot lose.
Heaven's reward… Whose God is true.
High is the sword… When arrows loose.

A fight for a land… Where jesus died.
A fight in the sand… To stay alive.
Then it began… Crusades in time.
When man killed man… And faith was blind.

The highest honor… To die for the cross. To protect & serve… At any cost.
Held high is the sword. Who wears the red cross. For God & church. No matter the loss.

Peasants & nobles… Traveled to see.
The hill of our lord… In calvary.
Killed on the way… No matter the plea.
You cannot stay… No one agreed.

For 200 years… The promise was real.
Thousands of knights… A peasant's shield.
A war for God… And a faith to feel.
To pray & fight… And finally kneel.

The highest honor… To die for the cross. To protect & serve… At any cost.
Held high is the sword. Who wears the red cross. For God & church. No matter the loss.

These were the men… The people placed.
Covered in steel… Hammer & mace.
A worthy shield… When evil was faced.
To live & feel… Then die in grace.

The highest honor… To die for the cross. To protect & serve… At any cost.
Held high is the sword. Who wears the red cross. For God & church. No matter the loss.

Legends in time… A templar's knight.
Red cross enshrined… On a mantel of white.
Defender of faith… For all that is right.
In God's way… With all of his might.

The highest honor… To die for the cross. To protect & serve… At any cost.
Held high is the sword. Who wears the red cross. For God & church. No matter the loss.
bio: Why it Began - Knights Templar - 1119 Crusades

title: Knights Templar: Taken Down
lyrics:
A battle cry… of pride & fear
Their swords held high… the promise clear
To fight & die… in blood & spear
Crusades in time… year after year

Forged by God… man made real
A holy fight… angels of steel
Who was right… time revealed
A templars knight… their fate was sealed

Time went on… power & fame
They grew strong… a templars name
Mace & steel… had no shame
Very real… in God's name

Then from fame… from battles won
The pope & king… conspired as one
They feared & blamed… a betrayal begun
And by the spring… lies were spun

Forged by God… man made real
A holy fight… angels of steel
Who was right… time revealed
A templars knight… their fate was sealed

Their faith accused… Christ denied
Swords removed… a body of spies
Then thieves were loose… all were lies
The templars rule… was burned alive

Forged by God… man made real
A holy fight… angels of steel
Who was right… time revealed
A templars knight… their fate was sealed

Now blood & years… the armor stained
The pride & fear… lost in pain
An angel of steel… a holy claim
God made real… a templar's name
bio: Gone… The relics of Christ, the wealth, the knights… It's in this mystery, the legends live on.

title: Not Broke Yet
lyrics:
In comes Jenny… Just past nine.
Welcome to Denny's… Read the sign.
Hair still wet… Ignores the line.
A damn good bet… Back in time.

I sat with doubt… A little inspired.
My life now… A dumpster fire.
I enquired… After a while.
You don't tire… Always a smile.

We're all the same… We're all a mess. A little bit cracked… But not broke yet.

She counted to three… Then turned my way.
Saw through me… And started to say.
Honey ya see… Back in the day.
Money for me… Was never the way.

I was made by passion… Then raised by a man.
Mamma ran off… Paw quit the band.
The good & bad… Go hand in hand.
Most days now… I'm just happy to stand.

Life is hard… So they say. We all have scars… In our own way.
But don't judge it… How I play. I'm on a beer can budget… Most of the day.

My advice to you… And any who cares.
Decide for yourself… Choose to dare.
Be proud of you… Lay the soul bare.
And never ever… Ever compare.

And so it went… No more no less.
She paid with change… Her hair a mess.
Our time now spent… But she confessed.
Gonna go buy me… A redneck dress.

We're all the same… We're all a mess. A little cracked… But not broke yet.
bio: A Denny's Encounter

title: Angels Loose
lyrics:
A Sunday drive… On a quiet day.
A simple ride… I'm on my way.
Fate decides… A different way.
She crossed that line… Oh God I prayed.

I don't recall… Who or why.
Or all the care… At my side.
But when I woke… My heart did cry.
I couldn't walk… God knows I tried.

A quiet pain… The sounds of fear.
I refrain… To hold back tears.
To win or lose… And how to heal.
I had to choose… How to feel.

Nothing to lose… and no excuse… I had to let… My angels loose.
To guide my way… From hell & back… A little each day… I fired back.

The healing began… Of this I'm certain.
With love of my man… Who carried my burden.
The mindful hands… Of all the surgeons.
And caring demands… Of God's own nurses.

Nothing to lose… and no excuse… I had to let… My angels loose.
To guide my way… From hell & back… A little each day… I fired back.

A little here… A little more.
Every day… I win a war.
Now a year… And some more.
My path is clear… Like before.

God helped me then… And helps me now.
My family stands… And shows me how.
A little bit better… Every day.
When angels guide… To show the way.

Nothing to lose… and no excuse… I had to let… My angels loose.
To guide my way… From hell & back… A little each day… I fired back.
bio: A Journey of Recovery and Faith

title: Missing Bullets
lyrics:
A gun without ammo… Is just a bluff.
It's big on show… But not enough.
One needs the other… When life gets tough.
They go together… Like a huff and a puff.

But what do you do… When bullets run.
They refuse… To load in life's gun.
People go missing… When they stop having fun.
Where do they go?… When they wanna be done.

Cheers to you… & cheers to me… A shot for you… And a beer for me.
High in your stool. We let it all be. There's only one rule. Home before 3.

Everyone here… Is just like a bullet.
Once ready to fire… But no trigger to pull it.
Now retired… They try not to push it.
Stacked in this bar… Like old missing bullets.

Cheers to you… & cheers to me… A shot for you… And a beer for me.
High in your stool. We let it all be. There's only one rule. Home before 3.

In here we find… The locked and loaded.
Friends of mine… Not yet imploded.
Like ammo in time… That never exploded.
Lost in their prime… A little corroded.

I can go on… The old girls & boys.
They smile a lot… And love the noise.
All bullets now gone… Long since employed.
A lovely spot… Of misfit toys.

Cheers to you… & cheers to me… A shot for you… And a beer for me.
High in your stool. We let it all be. There's only one rule. Home before 3.
bio: A Bar Full of Stories

title: Box Of Echoes
lyrics:
When I was nine… I took the time.
To keep some things… old friends of mine.
Each one I find… as one of a kind.
By design… all were mine.

Things I kept… at that time.
Were easy to get… like twirly twine.
And fun to find… like shiny dimes.
And really cool… new green slime.

Memories of old… frozen in time.
We hold them close… to help remind.
Placed in a box… to save as mine.
To warm the heart… echoes of mine.

As I grew… my box did too.
When life gave me… something new.
I'd find a thing… something true.
A one of a kind… sometimes two.

Echoes of love… each with hope.
Echoes of those… we miss the most.
Echoes of time… and all invoked.
Echoes of life… as musical notes.

Echoes of love… this I know.
You filled my life… you made it grow.
You filled my thoughts… you made it so.
You filled my box… each an echo.

Memories of old… frozen in time.
We hold them close… to help remind.
Placed in a box… to save as mine.
To warm the heart… echoes of mine.

To warm the heart… echoes of mine.
description:
Some of the best memories of life, are simply gifts from God.

For me, only the best ones are now saved now in a special box, always nearby.

May your Own Box be filled......way before the lid closes.

Dedicated to Mr. Bob Williams. He was our friend, who first sang this song in the dining room of Ave Maria Senior Home. He was gifted with a bigger than life personality and voice from God. He always made you smile and was big fan of Tank.
bio: May your box overflow, well before the lid closes.

title: Bam Bam Bam
lyrics:
Snow white chairs… placed with care.
The people stare… a formal affair.
They face one way… on wedding day.
The violin plays… soft and sway.

Then the wind blew… the fathers knew.
Rain was coming… we should move.
We're under a roof… not rain proof.
It's made of metal… someone goofed.

But the pastor goes on… he does what he can.
Let's get this done… bam. bam. bam.
The groom is stunned… the bride ran.
The rain bangs on… this big metal can.

Bam bam bam… the sound fantastic.
A metal can… the rain bombastic.
A new kind of band… the preacher drastic.
Do you take this man… at best was sarcastic.

It's over now… our senses were plowed.
No one can hear… we each yelled out loud.
Dad got a beer… but grandma looked proud.
She bought the steel… and the roof took a bow.

Bam bam bam… the sound fantastic.
A metal can… the rain bombastic.
A new kind of band… the preacher drastic.
Do you take this man… at best was sarcastic.

It's over now… our senses were plowed.
No one can hear… we each yelled out loud.
Dad got a beer… but grandma looked proud.
She bought the steel… and the roof took a bow.
description: You know that moment when you know you're not supposed to laugh, but you do anyway? Well.....This was that moment. True Story (most of it). One of Donna's weddings. Ended well. :)
bio: A Wedding Under a Metal Roof

title: Hillbilly Bar
lyrics:
Not too far… not far from here.
My hillbilly bar… I hold dear.
With smiles & scars… the rules are clear.
Come as you are… and stay for the beer.

In my bar… we like to toast.
We stand tall… and love to vote.
With one guitar… and two old goats.
All in all… we have hope.

Now here's a chance… to learn a song.
A hillbilly chant… you can sing along.
A bit of a rant… not too long.
Learn if you can… but keep your pants on.

These are my people… these are my friends. This is my bar… say it again.
These are my people… these are my friends. This is my bar… amen amen.

In here we dance… keep the blinds down.
Like army ants… all crawling around.
We say we can… until the bar shuts down.
Then a faceplant… sally went down.

Hardwood floors… & one bar maid.
We're all surprised… she chose to stay.
She looks bored… but happy to say.
Bless your heart… now do it my way.

Two cougars… and a peacock.
Lots of rumors… and a shock jock.
Some bad humor… knock knock.
Winner & losers… all in a crock pot.

These are my people… these are my friends. This is my bar… say it again.
These are my people… these are my friends. This is my bar… amen amen.
bio: You either have it… or want it. When you find it… sing it loud and proud.

title: Your Bow
lyrics:
Some years ago… you found your bow.
God said so… then music flowed.
Where to go… you didn't know.
But with each note… I followed.

As you played… the people would show.
Heads would sway… to & fro.
As they stayed… their hearts did grow.
And on those days… I found my soul.

When you play… fast or slow. I find my way, I find my soul.
I love the way… my heart grows… when you play… I find my soul.

In day or night… both the same.
We smile & cry… we feel the rain.
Your bow helps tie… our joy & pain.
We don't ask why… it's in God's name.

When you play… fast or slow. I find my way, I find my soul.
I love the way… my heart grows… when you play… I find my soul.

Ohh ohh ohh… ohh ohh ohh…
Now we know… where to go.
We hope you play… until we're old.
This gift in kind… is your bow.
To help us find… to find our soul.

When you play… fast or slow. I find my way, I find my soul.
I love the way… my heart grows… when you play… I find my soul.
When you play… I find my soul.
bio: A Love Song Tribute inspired by the Talented Donna Wolf

title: Wall of Stone
lyrics:
The time had come… My heart was numb.
One deep sigh… The long good-bye.
We stood tall… Children and all.
Heads bowed in awe… For God's last call.

Soldiers in line… It's almost time.
Pride in chest… At parade rest.
Now we stand… And hear the command.
Two in stride… Not their first time.

A flag they hold… Corner to corner.
13 folds… In your honor.
The soldier finds his next in line.
Tears now climb… Can't stop time.

5 rifles high. Into the sky.
3 shots fired. 15 retired.
Shells to the ground. Makes a sound.
I now hold… Deep deep down.

15 shells and a wall of stone. Locked inside but not alone.
Shells to the ground. Now a sound. That I hold dear… Deep deep down.

Last in the row… A bugle blows.
Taps an echo… Tears now flow.
All is silent… We stand alone.
Not your home… This tall wall of stone.

It's later now… Hard to believe.
Few know how… These shells remind me.
I am your son… and proud to be.
I am your son… Yeah this is me.
bio:
Respect - Love of Parents
A Final Celebration

title: Chains Of St. James
lyrics:
In 1831… Under a hot sun.
Sugar and slaves… Were bound as one.
It was always known… Not to be undone.
Owned by a throne… And ruled by a gun.
But in old St James… On a cold Christmas day.
This would change… In every way.

To the souls… Who fought & prayed.
You broke these old chains… On that day.

Led by a cross… The slaves without a cost.
Armed with rage… They rose up day.
They set fires ablaze… For each to say.
Be on your way… Be free this day.
For 11 days… They all defied.
Then they paid… With 500 lives.

To the souls… Who fought & prayed.
You broke these old chains… On that day.

And their leader… A Baptist preacher.
On that day… Was hung… in Montego Bay.

To the souls… Who fought & prayed.
You broke these old chains… On that day.

We know today… This was not in silent pain.
You did not die… Did not die in vain.
By 1834… A new law was made.
There will be no more… Chains in St James.
No more… No more chains in St James.
bio: Baptist War of 1831

title: Whistling Past The Graveyard
lyrics:
My shoulder hurts… it feels rusty.
My eyes are worse… yeah they must be.
My friend's a nurse… she can fix me.
I'll be all right… she convinced me.

I'm just whistling past the graveyard… just whistling past the graveyard.
All is good & rosy with me… all is good & rosy with me.

That's a bruise… and it will heal.
That's a tattoo… no big deal.
Not those shoes… I can't kneel.
I'm not confused… is that thing real.

I am just fine… my ships not sinking.
What do you mean… I stopped blinking.
That's not wine… I stopped drinking.
Hold on wait… I'm still thinking.

I'm just whistling past the graveyard… just whistling past the graveyard.
All is good & rosy with me… all is good & rosy with me.

Who is she… she's my driver.
She came… sooner than I'd like her.
The car behind me… it was first.
Wait now… that a hearse.

I'm not whistling past the graveyard… I'm not whistling past the graveyard.
All is good & rosy with me… so good & rosy with me.
bio: Just keep whistling... whatever it is will go away... eventually.

title: Beer in the Air
lyrics:
High in the air… Over my head
The beer can flew… Nothing was said…
It came with a glare… She wanted me dead…
Somehow I knew… Now a code red…

I opened my mouth... Too many times…
And said with doubt… Dinner was fine…
But in truth I feel…. It needed some wine…
No big deal… Then rose and shined…

From over the left… I felt the shift…
A tone in the air… She was now pissed…
A shivering stare…. I saw the rift…
A can in the air… She let it rip…

From under the chair… I dove in fear…
Not for my head… Her miss was near…
A prayer instead… My love my dear…
Very aware….. She had my beer…

One by one at blazing speed… She fired each one, straight at me…
One by one she did the deed… Took her stand to make me see…
One by one I held my voice… From under that chair I made that choice…
One by one 12 in a pack… Her bullet of choice emptied the rack…

It's quiet now… She's out of ammo…
She missed somehow... I wore my camo…
Why and how… I'll never know…
My beers all gone… I can go…

This battles done… It didn't last…
No one won… It's in the past…
But learned a ton …To hide my ass…
And to never ever ever… Buy beer in glass…
bio: That moment when you realize you've said too much.

title: Winnie The Pooh
lyrics:
A cool wind blows… The sound of leaves…
Ends the day… Now daddy leads…
A spooky night…. Bend the trees…
A shoulder ride… On Halloween…

How & why… I don't know who…
Decided you … As Winnie the Pooh…
You were shy…. This was new…
It all flew by…. You lost a shoe…

Now candy drives…. This strange tradition…
Fill the bag…. Became your mission…
On your own…. With no permission…
You run & roam… A great magician…

Time flew fast…. As Spider Man
Then at last… Came Super Man
Then a flash… A proud young man…
To love & laugh… A girl in hand…

So here I stand that daddy ride…
From years ago you by my side…
A memory now I hold with pride…
Your a man time flew by…

Now my job… Is at the door…
A bowl in hand… Grand dad's chore…
Kinda sad… Like Eeyore…
But kinda glad… I look some more…

Here you come… With all your crew
Ready to go... On shoulders new…
A daddy ride… Was Winnie the Pooh…
And to your side…. Now Tigger too…
bio: Time Flies By.

title: All The Hens
lyrics:
Two girls chatting… Starts this fable…
The bar was stocked… Ready and able
The talk was steady... Both now ready…
It grew to a gal…. No one inhaled…

The doors burst open... Side by side…
4 more friends… The noise did rise…
Six in all… All were gappin…
Mouths wide open… All were yappin…

All hens cluckin… It was a mugging… No mouths shutting… My ears a hummin…
A funny kind of sound... Drinks all around... Those hens a cluckin…

The noise was crippling… No one listening…
Makin a sound… My senses drowned…
Then I realized… A super-power
Cluckin and listening… Hour by hour

All hens cluckin… It was a mugging… No mouths shutting… My ears a hummin…
A funny kind of sound... Drinks all around... Those hens a cluckin…

High heals on & red lipstick
Looking for a man that just might fit…
One for the money two for the show
Three to get ready and four to go…

All hens cluckin… It was a mugging… No mouths shutting… My ears a hummin…
A funny kind of sound... Drinks all around... Those hens a cluckin…
bio: That moment you realize all the women in the bar, are all talking… AT THE SAME TIME.

title: The Horns of Heaven
lyrics:
A flower blooms… A lilly born
An angel's tune …On golden horn…
The world is new… The time is morn…
A gift for you… Safe and warm…

But prophets tell… The earth will pass…
Heaven or hell... You must ask…
Books foretell… John's was last…
A last farewell… Then it passed…

Trumpets blow… Drums will pound… It's time to go… All around…
Long ago… Angels bound… God said so… When trumpets sound…

Loud & true… From heaven's horn…
All for you … The earth was born
But like the bloom… It has a thorn…
A horn for you… To let it warn…

Trumpets blow… Drums will pound… It's time to go… All around…
Long ago… Angels bound… God said so… When trumpets sound…

Bless the psalms… And Peter too…
Bless be John… Who says it true…
Bless be Christ… He came for you…
Bless be God…. His time is due…

Trumpets blow… Drums will pound… It's time to go… All around…
Long ago… Angels bound… God said so… When trumpets sound…

Hell will boast… The world will fall…
The horns will blow… We are called…
God will know… No more wall…
A time to go… One and all…
bio: The end of times as we know it.

title: Crosses & Queens
lyrics:
For 5 long years… In castles tall.
With pikes & spears… Guarding the walls.
The queen appeared… With crosses in halls.
To me adhere… Or lose it all.

For 5 long years… The fires burned.
Farmers feared… No one learned.
Crosses & tears… Heaven was blurred.
The queen was clear… The pope you serve.

When power leads with an iron hand.
Vengeance feeds & takes a stand.
5 years long this queen burned.
But with time gone, lessons learned.

For 5 long years… Behind their moats.
The flames & fears… & deadly smoke.
Heaven was dear… But a burning hope.
Fanned & seared… By an angry pope.

When power leads with an iron hand.
Vengeance feeds & takes a stand.
5 years long this queen burned.
But with time gone, lessons learned.

Time shows… The banner she carried.
God knows… The people were wary.
Long ago… Her name now buried.
She was known… "Bloody Mary".

When power leads with an iron hand.
Vengeance feeds & takes a stand.
5 years long this queen burned.
But with time gone, lessons learned.
bio: Bloody Mary 1555

title: Collierville
lyrics:
A Tennessee town… the stories say.
That nearly burned down… in civil war days.
A Bible town… we are today.
Where church bells ring… to keep it that way.

This is our home. A place we all share.
We're very well known. Cause we all care.
Time has shown. With a little prayer.
You're never alone. When you're on the square.

In time we grew… from wagons & trails.
Much of it new… from cotton bales.
The work was true… this town would not fail.
Even when moonshine… rushed its one jail.

This is our home. A place we all share.
We're very well known. Cause we all care.
Time has shown. With a little prayer.
You're never alone. When you're on the square.

Later a crime… a pain not wanted.
Shots fired froze time… for some still haunted.
God bless our blue line… they all responded.
For your hearts climb… you are wanted.

This is our home. A place we all share.
We're very well known. Cause we all care.
Time has shown. With a little prayer.
You're never alone. When you're on the square.

With parks & trains… and even some bars.
Where bluegrass reigns… with strings & guitars.
Where Bibles & preachers… heal old scars.
And all school teachers… are still rock stars.

A town still small… a home we build.
Where songs say y'all… and the wind is still.
A town for us all… and for some a thrill.
We're proud to still call… Collierville.
bio: A town still small… a home we build.

title: Crosses & Gunpowder
lyrics:
There was a time… when no one escaped.
A pain of two sides… a holy fate.
They killed to survive… an evil state.
When all the pride… turned to hate.

Guy Fawkes was his name… he had to die.
Killed by King James… tortured & tried.
They were never the same… the church had lied.
The people became… a war of two sides.

Castles & walls… behind church doors… crosses in halls… were all ignored.
Battles & brawls… killing & more… now songs fall… to a cannon's roar.

One side ruled… they had to fall.
Guy held the fuse… to kill them all.
Their time was due… blow up the hall.
The kegs were new… gunpowder in all.

For his kin… this must be done.
My side wins… by morning's sun.
Maybe a sin… for Jesus the son.
Now war begins… light it and run.

He didn't know… a letter betrayed.
Warning the lords… to get out of the way.
Caught in the cellar… at end of day.
His fatal error… Guy chose to stay.

Castles & walls… behind church doors… crosses in halls… were all ignored.
Battles & brawls… killing & more… now songs fall… to a cannon's roar.

We believe in one God… when all said & done.
And the glory of love… from his only son.
But pride of man… is where war begun.
They had to stand… there was nowhere to run.
bio: Guy Fawkes - Bonfire Day 1605

title: Crosses & Tears
lyrics:
There was a time… deep in fear.
When man held high… a cross & spear.
The how & why… was never clear.
They killed & died… year on year.

A holy war… deep in pain.
The sins of man… an angry chain.
The tears of God… they fell like rain.
When man killed man… all in vain.

Muskets & pikes… gunpowder & led… who was right… with 5 million dead.
Pistols & spears… cast iron & steel… famine & fear… for 30 long years.

As castles grew… across the land.
These kings ruled… with iron hands.
What was true… take a stand.
Both sides used… the soul of man.

God was why… they said the most.
The father son… & holy ghost.
But time has shown… it was the pope.
His rules of man… they hated most.

Muskets & pikes… gunpowder & led… who was right… with 5 million dead.
Pistols & spears… cast iron & steel… famine & fear… for 30 long years.

Only God knows… why these men died.
Why the church ruled… with power & pride.
When God was used… the church had lied.
This was when… when heaven cried.

Muskets & pikes… gunpowder & led… who was right… with 5 million dead.
Pistols & spears… cast iron & steel… famine & fear… for 30 long years.
bio: When heaven cried… the 30 year war - 1618

title: Help
lyrics:
High is the wall… I've built my own.
I made it tall… And time has grown.
I try to climb… The top unknown.
I feel it bind… I feel alone.

I put this here… I made it real.
I told myself… Not to feel.
It's made of fear… And will not yield.
My way unclear… My path it steals.

I can, I will, I did before… You came to me… To help and more.
I do, I see, I will again… You found in me… You helped, my friend.

When you came… Bold and clear.
Without blame… Or in fear.
You made a claim… And made me hear.
In his name… He was near.

I can, I will, I did before… You came to me… To help and more.
I do, I see, I will again… You found in me… You helped, my friend.

When you came… Bold and clear.
Without blame… Or in fear.
You made a claim… And made me hear.
In his name… He was near.

I can, I will, I did before… You came to me… To help and more.
I do, I see, I will again… You found in me… You helped, my friend.

I now can see… I'm not alone.
I now can say… You brought me home.
I now can hear… The seed is sown.
I now can feel… My path is known.

I can, I will, I did before… You came to me… To help and more.
I do, I see, I will again… You found in me… You helped, my friend.

The wall is down… It's time is gone.
On the ground… In bits of stone.
My faith is sound… I am home.
I see it now… Never alone.
bio: No matter what phase of life, or challenge faced… you can, you will, you did before… rely…

title: Over The Line
lyrics:
There was a young man… from deep in the pines.
Far in the north… where the cold wind binds.
He traveled the land… to look and to find.
Did all that he can… to leave it behind.

No purpose or plan… nothing in sight.
He ran and he ran… then ran out of sight.
Then stopped on demand… early one night.
A sign in his hand… lit by the light.

Cotton bails… and mossy trees… bless your heart… and sweet teas.
Rusty nails… and hard red clay… sweaty nights… and sunny days.

Not just a sign… a matter of fact.
Not just a line… on any old map.
Dixon designed… with Mason to track.
This was not fine… turn and go back.

Yes ma'am… and hush ya'll… bluegrass band… and whisky balls.
Hotter'n hell… when preachers call… southern bells… & southern balls.

The sounds in the night… a new kinda song.
Some were just right… but some were just wrong.
He tried to fight… he tried to be strong.
Decide in the light… it didn't take long.

Tin roofs and honey suckle… whisky proof and funny chuckles.
Kudzu vines and high steeples… homemade wine and happy people.

To stay or to go… all will be fine.
He just didn't know… but when came the time.
His feet said to go… he ran over the line.
First fast then slow… but he kept the sign.

Cicayda buzzin… loud and true… mama's hummin… prayin' for you.
Fixen this, and fixen that… what's that sound… damn roof rats.
bio: The Mason-Dixon Line of 1767

title: Forged In A Fire - Revenge
lyrics:
Forged in a fire… Deep deep down.
Thoughts conspire… Without a sound.
Pain and desire… Go round & round.
Anger on fire… Senses drowned.

Revenge is a metal… That does not rust.
It comes from the devil… The brother of lust.
Time made it cold… Hurts to touch.
Ugly and old… Do not trust.

Dear God a prayer… On this day… My soul is bare… Help my way.
Help me see… And help me know… Set this free… And let this go.

Revenge lives… And wants to grow.
But it kills… Mind & soul.
Anger burns… And takes a hold.
Hard to turn… & let it go.

Time will show… You do not need.
You need to know… Take this heed.
It wiggles & taunts… & wants to feed.
To heckle & haunt… And never leave.

Dear God a prayer… On this day… My soul laid bare… Help my way.
Help me see… And help me know… Set this free… And let this go.

Thank you God… For hearing me.
Thank you God… To help me see.
Take this fire… Deep in me.
Your love is higher… I am free.
bio: It is in the fires of life, where lessons are forged.

title: Forged In A Fire - Anger
lyrics:
From deep deep down… It's born from sin.
It goes all around… And plays to win.
When you let it out… It feeds from within.
Round & round… And round again.

Anger will rule… If left unchecked.
It is the fuel… That time regrets.
Then pretty soon… It's all that's left.
You feel the fool… If it is kept.

Anger & fire… In time we learn… Hope & desire… Are better to burn.
Now is the day… And you are the why… Put the gun away… & keep your powder dry.

As a young man… I'd fire away.
An angry stand… I'd have my say.
Hate would guide… Words would spray.
Some were a lie… But I had my way.

Anger & fire… In time we learn… Hope & desire… Are better to burn.
Now is the day… And you are the why… Put the gun away… & keep your powder dry.

When you fire your gun at all within sight.
There's nowhere to run if you lead with spite.
It's hard to see to know what is right.
It's hard to lead when blinded by fight.

Anger & fire… In time we learn… Hope & desire… Are better to burn.
Now is the day… And you are the why… Put the gun away… & keep your powder dry.

Hold your fire… The anger will die.
Hope and desire… Are better to try.
Now you see… You are the why.
Let it all be… Keep the powder dry.
bio: It's from the fires of life… where lessons are forged.

title: Forged In A Fire - Addiction
lyrics:
The when and why… This came to be.
How well you lied… I did not see.
In my eyes… You lied to me.
I didn't try… To fight or flee.

A little each day… Was the deal we made.
In this way… I just obeyed.
I made that choice… And then you stayed.
An angry voice… Now my life invades.

Round and round and round again… The fire inside… Is not a friend.
Learn to fight… Learn to bend… Make this right… It has to end.

You wiggled your way… In mind and soul.
I wobbled and swayed… And lost control.
In time I prayed… For days gone old.
But you still stayed… Hungry & bold.

Round and round and round again… The fire inside… Is not a friend.
Learn to fight… Learn to bend… Make this right… It has to end.

With lots of prayer… And several years.
The demon's stare… And failure's tear.
You're gone for now… And so the fear.
God showed me how… I now hold dear.

Round and round and round again… The fire inside… Is not a friend.
Learn to fight… Learn to bend… Make this right… It has to end.

It's over now… I'm past the shame.
The why & how… I hold the blame.
I see the lie… I know the pain.
The lie I tried… I now tame.
bio: It is in the fires of life, where lessons are forged.
